## Teams

Every FBS team has a page: its power rating and offense and defense by week, its poll ranks, and every game, for each season since {{< meta cfb.first_season >}}. The [team index](/cfb/teams/) lists them by conference with records and power-rating ranks.

```{=html}
<div id="team-grid" class="team-grid"><div class="loading">Loading…</div></div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const S = Sparvi, [teams, meta] = await Promise.all([S.load("/data/cfb/teams.json"), S.load("/data/cfb/meta.json")]);
  // This season's teams by conference; teams that have left FBS go last.
  const cur = teams.filter(t => t.seasons.includes(meta.season)), gone = teams.filter(t => !t.seasons.includes(meta.season));
  const confs = d3.groups(cur, t => t.conf).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a[0] === "FBS Independents", b[0] === "FBS Independents") || d3.ascending(a[0], b[0]));
  if (gone.length) confs.push(["Former FBS teams", gone]);
  document.getElementById("team-grid").replaceChildren(...confs.map(([conf, ts]) =>
    S.el("div", { class: "team-div" }, S.el("h4", {}, conf),
      S.el("ul", {}, ts.map(t => S.el("li", { html: S.cfbTeamLink(t, t.name) }))))));
})();
</script>
```
